title: ResourceType
description: A kind: ResourceType file as the platform change P-06 leaves it: today's fields (metadata, schema, states, producedBy, visibility) plus metadata.service, the console block, the observe block and the x-console keywords inside the schema. Every new block is optional, so the five sample types at c9529d5 validate unchanged. The platform's own copy of this schema (packages/workflow-checks/schemas/resource-type.schema.json) is the first line of the P-06 checks; this is the hub's draft of it.

schema.description: The JSON Schema of a resource's attributes: what a register step must match, what the console draws its list, detail and forms from

states.description: The states a resource of the type moves through; building, ready, deprecated and retired when left out

producedBy.description: The workflow whose register step creates this type; the console's Create button is keyed off it

visibility.description: What new resources of the type get: team (the owner team's) or public (every team's); hidden (P-19) keeps a type with live resources out of Create

name.description: The type's name, the type segment of its wfrns

plural.description: The collection noun of the generated reads (/api/v1/<plural>); <name>s when left out

service.description: P-06: the console's service grouping and the service segment of the wfrn; the owner team without its team- prefix when left out (check resourceType.service.invalid)

objectSchema.description: An object JSON Schema whose properties may carry x-console; other JSON Schema keywords are allowed and left to the meta-schema

propertySchema.description: One field of a resource: any JSON Schema, with the optional x-console hints the console reads

xConsole.description: P-06: hints for the console inside a schema field. The platform ignores them at run time and checks them (xConsole.format.unknown, xConsole.mutable.noUpdateWorkflow, xConsole.sensitive.searchable)

column.description: Shown as a list column by default

searchable.description: Indexed for the filter bar and the global search; never together with sensitive

sensitive.description: Masked, never indexed, never in events

mutable.description: Editable through the type's update workflow (P-08); needs a published workflow with verb update

operational.description: P-08: an input of an update workflow that is not a field of the resource (reason, environment)

group.description: A section on forms and detail pages

help.description: A link to an info panel

console.description: P-06: how the console shows the type; every key is optional and has a default drawn from the schema and the workflows

title.description: The service page title; the plural, capitalised, when left out

icon.description: A name from the Atlas icon set; a generic box when left out

columns.description: Schema fields and the built-in columns name, status, wfrn, owner, created, updated (check console.column.unknownField)

defaultSort.description: A column, with a leading - for descending

tabs.description: The known tabs, in the order shown (check console.tab.unknown)

lifecycle.description: The type's states mapped to the console's lifecycle classes; by name when left out (checks console.lifecycle.unknownState, console.lifecycle.unknownClass)

expression.description: An expression of the platform's ExpressionEngine, usually inside {{ }}, with the roots $resource, $region, $json and $item

expressionInput.description: The input of a provider action: field names to literals or expressions

observe.description: P-06: how drift detection reads the truth from the provider (P-09 executes it). The action must be a published provider's action with effect read.

action.description: A read action of the provider (checks observe.action.unknown, observe.action.notRead)

map.description: Observed field to the expression over the action's response that yields it; every key is a schema field (check observe.map.unknownField)

interval.description: How often a resource of the type is read on the warm tier; at least 1m (check observe.interval.tooShort). A number with a unit (15m, 1h, 2d) or an ISO 8601 duration (PT15M)

notFound.description: What a not_found answer means: missing (the default) or deleted

discover.description: Optional: list what the provider has, managed or not (P-09 :discover)

items.description: The expression for the array in the response; $json.items when left out

id.description: The expression for one item's provider id; $item.id when left out

list.description: Optional: a read action that pages, for P-09's :observe-list; a type without it is observed one resource at a time

request.description: The input field the next cursor goes back in

response.description: The expression for the next cursor in the response

metrics.description: Optional: a read action for CPU, memory, disk and similar series (P-09 :metrics); a type without it has no monitoring tab

map.description: Series name to the expression over the response

actionId.description: A provider action id, such as vm.get

cost.description: P-22: which price of the platform's price lists prices a resource of this type, read by the console's cost service (hub decision 25). Optional: a type without it is unpriced.

provider.description: The provider of the priced action, as the price list names it

by.description: The resource attribute whose value is looked up when the price is per value (the price's own `by`); read from the last observation when there is one, else from the desired attributes
